title: Hello World: A Narrated Video Made From One JSON File

beats.narration: This whole video was made from one JSON file. No camera, no editing app, no cloud. A free voice reads each line on this computer, and the pictures move when the voice says their word.

visual.headline: A video made from one JSON file
visual.sub: voice, timing and animation, all on your own machine

beats.narration: Here is a real program, run on this computer. It splits one sentence into words and counts them. Run it, and it prints nine words. The longest one is picture.

visual.title: A real program, really run
visual.source: Measured . the file and its output from evidence/code-run.json (Node v22.16.0)

lines: const line = "Every picture moves when the voice says its word";

beats.narration: Each scene in the file is data plus cues. A cue names a spoken word, and the cursor or the highlight arrives exactly when the voice says it. Change the words, voice it again, and every cue moves with them.

visual.headline: How a scene knows when to move
items: The script names a spoken word: "@program"
Whisper measures when that word is said
The frame renders the cue at that moment

beats.narration: Before anything is published, the checks run. A machine listens to every line, a contact sheet shows every scene, and each number has to come from a real file.

visual.text: Check it before you publish it
visual.sub: speech check, contact sheets, numbers traced to files

beats.narration: Write a script, run one command, and look at every frame. Make your own.
